title: GMI theme-graph edge row v1
description: One ROW of data/theme_graph/edges.parquet, as a JSON object. Masterplan §4.1/§4.4, gates G0.2 (point-in-time law) and G0.6 (LLM law). The store is APPEND-ONLY and BITEMPORAL: a fact is never edited in place — a later belief about the same edge_id is a NEW row with a later belief_time, and the read view takes the max-belief_time row per edge_id. Closing an interval therefore appends a row carrying valid_to; the open row stays on disk forever as what was believed then. Contradictory evidence coexists as rows; nothing nets. The three exposure axes are RESERVED-NULL in W1b: they are continuous quantities with formula ids (W2's R1 probe measures them), and the *_display enums are glance-tier rounding of those quantities, never an input to one.

edge_id.description: Deterministic: '<type_lower>:<src>-><dst>@<valid_from>'. Stable across rebuilds, so a re-run appends nothing when nothing changed.

valid_from.description: VALID time: when the fact became true in the world.

valid_to.description: Null while the fact is still true. A closed interval never deletes the row that opened it.

evidence_time.description: When the EVIDENCE for this edge was published/observed.

belief_time.description: When THIS system came to believe it — the run date. A backfill's belief_time is the backfill's own date, never the reconstructed past.

era.description: reconstruction = assembled from curated/seed dates after the fact; it is NEVER promotion evidence (G0.2, Konseki authenticated-vs-reconstruction). observed = the nightly saw the change happen.

source_class.description: llm_proposed_ratified edges must carry >=1 dated evidence ref — the semantic-leakage law (§4.4): membership recalled from a model's general knowledge is undatable and forbidden.

date_provenance.description: How valid_from was obtained. seed_constant is the honesty flag that matters: CN membership docs seed every first-run member at the fixed cache-start constant, so that date is a CONVENTION, not an observation.

evidence_refs.description: evidence_id values resolving into evidence.parquet. Every edge has at least one; corroborating refs are appended, never merged.

confidence_basis.description: Deterministic formula/derivation id, never a bare number without a basis. W1b constant: 'membership_doc.v1'.

reserved_share.description: RESERVED-NULL until W2. A measured share of the named quantity, with its formula id alongside.

reserved_number.description: RESERVED-NULL until W2. A measured continuous quantity, with its formula id alongside.

reserved_string.description: RESERVED-NULL until W2. The deterministic formula id that produced the quantity beside it.

exposure_display.description: RESERVED-NULL until W2. Glance-tier ROUNDING of the continuous axis beside it — presentation only, never an input to a measurement, never an ordering key (G0.11).
